summary: Configured and restart-validated internal time synchronization. node1 serves NTP to the cluster subnet; node2 uses node1 as its sole source and actively selects it. AlmaLinux 9.6 and kernel 5.14.0-570.12.1.el9_6 were preserved.
actions_performed: Configured node1 chronyd to allow clients from 10.100.95.0/24.
Added a persistent firewalld rule permitting NTP only from the internal subnet.
Configured node2 with only `server 10.100.95.10 iburst prefer`, removing public and DHCP-provided sources.
Verified node1 observes NTP requests from node2 and node2 marks node1 as its selected online source.

Restarted nodes sequentially and verified changed boot identities plus full service recovery. node1 experienced an additional sequential reboot while validating its delayed reboot acknowledgement; node2 was not restarted concurrently.
Installed no packages and made no operating-system or kernel changes.

evidence.requirement: node1 is the internal time source
evidence.summary: chronyd is active/enabled and synchronized, listens on UDP/123, permits 10.100.95.0/24, has a matching persistent firewall rule, and records node2 (10.100.95.11) as an NTP client.
The sole configured source is 10.100.95.10; live chrony output marks it `*` selected and reports one source online with none offline.

evidence.requirement: Installed OS release and kernel were preserved
evidence.summary: Both nodes remained AlmaLinux 9.6 with kernel 5.14.0-570.12.1.el9_6; the existing chrony 4.6.1 package was used.

Evidence captures the healthy baseline, reboot acknowledgements, changed boot identity, and recovery with the system running, chronyd synchronized and serving UDP/123, and persisted firewall/configuration.

evidence.requirement: Full cluster health before restarting node2
evidence.summary: After node1 recovered, node2 reported NTPSynchronized=yes and node1 as its selected online source.
The boot ID changed from d527ba47-92aa-4f54-ada4-47dc01086077 to 1df060cd-19df-4b77-b860-dbde6b91993e; chronyd recovered active/enabled and synchronized with node1 selected.

evidence.requirement: Final end-to-end health after all restarts
evidence.summary: node1 directly observes node2 as an NTP client, while node2 directly reports node1 selected and online.
